purpose: Mind+ V2 supportDevices dictionary shared by creation and conversion. The skill is self-contained: this embedded dictionary plus the generated corpus are all a first-time author needs. Local example projects are never required.
evidence_policy: Two evidence sources, both embedded at build time: official development docs (C1, mindplus2-docs-cn upload-mode guide, mirrored in generated/upload/config.md) and verified working ext2 projects (C2, maintainer corpus). New entries require one of these and must record the source here.
runtime_independence: Nothing in this file assumes example projects exist on the user machine. Provenance below records where each entry was learned, not a runtime dependency.
version_spec_format: ^<major>.<minor>.<patch> (all verified entries and the official docs example use ^0.0.1)
unknown_device_recovery: Pick boards from this dictionary by board name. If the user's target board is not listed: (1) search the official mind-plus Gitee organization for an extension supporting that board and read its config.json supportDevices (official-corpus.md protocol, C2-official evidence); (2) ask the user for the exact dev-DFRobot-... ID (visible in Mind+ or its official docs); (3) scope by architecture instead via supportArch, or omit supportDevices for a whole-arch extension. Never invent or approximate an ID, and propose the verified new entry as a dictionary update afterwards.

sku_format.empty: No DFRobot SKU product (communication/board extensions): use "".
sku_format.multi: Multiple boards of one family joined with |, e.g. "SEN0664|SEN0665".

support_arch.format_rule: Each entry is "all" or a board architecture prefix: the first two segments of boardConfig.board, e.g. "arduino:avr", "arduino:samd" (official docs, C1).
support_arch.usage: supportArch overrides supportDevices when both are set (official docs). Whole-arch extension: ["all"] with devices omitted; arch-family extension (upload mode): ["<platform>:<arch>"] instead of enumerating boards; device-scoped extension: supportDevices only. Do not set both without evidence.
